environment.Method: Alternating pre-batch and current binaries, same host, full WS/RPC/MySQL/Kafka/WS path, login setup outside measurements

methodology.model: closed loop, exactly one in-flight request per sender, fixed-count bursts
methodology.warmup: 100 messages per case, excluded from measurements, drain before measurement
methodology.note: Same Windows host and shared local Docker resources. This is a bounded comparison, not sustainable capacity.
methodology.login: Fixtures generated with project JWT/session functions; live WebSocket authentication and permission RPC remain enabled

notes: Averages are means of trial statistics. Mean trial P95 is not a pooled P95.
The fixed request count creates short bursts, not sustainable capacity measurements.
The load driver shares the host. SQL pool budgets, fsync settings, fanout, payload and publisher implementation were held constant.
Zero counterUpdates/messageInserts in raw trial data means prepared DML digests were unavailable. Do not interpret them as zero executions.
COMMIT digest observations can lag or be incomplete; they illustrate batching but are not exact DML counts.
Raw local fixtures/configs contain temporary credentials; this exported artifact excludes them.
